title: clipboard
description: Vision v2 (`vision_clipboard`): text for the PC's clipboard. Sent on the Vision channel, only for the admin whose session the PC user accepted: an "ask the user" session (not a mandatory one) that was the only open session for the device when the Vision tunnel opened. The agent refuses it otherwise (`capability_denied`). The server writes the direction and length to the audit log before sending, never the text.

text.description: Text only, at most 64 KB (65536 bytes) as UTF-8.
